title: bro plan — query
description: Structural contract for a `kind = "query"` TOML plan — the parsed document `parseQueryPlan` (packages/query/src/plan.ts) consumes. Cross-field rules stay in that validator: graphql documents must be read-only (no mutation/subscription keywords after comment/string stripping) and step ids must be unique.

version.description: Schema pin — must not exceed QUERY_PLAN_VERSION (latest: 1)

concurrency.description: Fan-out cap — default comes from the query.concurrency config

id.description: The output key — must be unique across steps (validator-checked)

provider.description: Data-plane connector name (github, gitlab, atlassian, …) — never a providers[] model-plane entry

graphql.description: The raw GraphQL document — v1 is read-only; mutation/subscription are rejected by the validator

vars.description: [steps.vars] — serialized as CLI fields or the JSON variables body, per connector

env.description: [steps.env] — literal string→string overlay; execution-shaping vars are operator-config only

steps.graphql: query ($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { pullRequests(first: 20, states: OPEN) { nodes { number title url } } } }
